prompts.name: petting
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent desktop-pet animation sprite sheet. Use the attached snack sheet ONLY as character/style reference; remove snack. Cinnamoroll: white puppy, very long floppy ears, blue eyes, pink cheeks, cinnamon-brown fine outlines, tiny spiral tail, soft clean shading. EXACTLY eight full-body frames in a uniform 4 columns by 2 rows grid, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Each frame centered in its own square with generous transparent margins, entire ears and feet visible. Same anatomy, scale and ground baseline across all frames. Exactly two arms and two feet, no extra limbs, no human hand, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no watermark, no scenery. Genuine transparent background. Frames form a gentle seamless cycle. Match reference illustration quality.
Animation: Enjoying head pats: paws relaxed beside tummy, eyes close contentedly, head dips gently, ears soften and subtly rise again, warm blush and tiny contented smile. No hand or prop. Frame1 eyes half closed,2 closing,3 dip,4 deeper contented dip,5 slight head lean,6 relax,7 lift,8 returns almost to1.
